extracted.name: Fast Salmon with a Ginger Glaze
extracted.description: Chef John's fast, delicious ginger, garlic, seasoned rice wine vinegar, brown sugar, chili sauce, and soy sauce glaze recipe is perfect on grilled salmon.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon hot chile paste (such as sambal oelek)
instruction_lines: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate. Season salmon fillets with salt.
Cook salmon on the preheated grill until it easily flakes with a fork, 6 to 8 minutes per side.

Combine water, rice wine vinegar, brown sugar, garlic, chili paste, ginger, and soy sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer until barely thickened, about 2 minutes.
Sprinkle basil on top of salmon; spoon glaze over top.
